proves.claim: claimBlock claims every open member of a block for one seat in one write, each with its claim event and the same lease, and another seat claim of a member is refused.

store.blocks.claim-all-members.why: A block is one unit of work for one seat, so its members are taken together or not at all.

proves.claim: claimBlock refuses an unknown name with NO_BLOCK, a member held by another seat with BLOCK_CLAIMED naming it and nothing claimed, and a seat below the block tier with BLOCK_TIER.

store.blocks.claim-refusals.why: A block claim takes every member or none, and only a seat whose route reaches the tier.
